🔄 I'd swap Triceps Pushdown for Lateral Raise. It barely loads the elbow, so it's a good pick today. Dips and overhead extensions stress the elbow even more, so I'd skip those. Tap Swap on the card to make the change.

⚠️ Bench and overhead press load the elbow too, so lower the weight if they bother it. If the pain is sharp or doesn't go away, stop and get it checked by a professional. Does the elbow hurt during pressing too?
